name: Copper/Gold Ratio: Does It Predict SPY Forward Returns?
description: Analyzes the copper/gold ratio as a macro growth signal. Uses 63-day ROC to classify the ratio as rising (risk-on) or falling (risk-off), then measures SPY forward 3-month returns in each regime. Includes ratio context chart, regime return comparison bars, return distribution boxplot, and summary statistics table with N, median, hit rate, best, and worst.
source:
# Copper/Gold Ratio → SPY Forward 3-Month Returns
# Signal: 63-day ROC of Cu/Au ratio (rising = risk-on, falling = risk-off)
# Forward returns: 63 trading days (~3 months) on SPY price

# --- Data ---
spy = market_data_source()()
spy_close = spy.c

# Copper (HG) — NoAdjustment to preserve cross-commodity ratio
hg_raw = common_reference_futures(ticker=ReferenceFutures.HG)()
hg = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment)(hg_raw.o, hg_raw.h, hg_raw.l, hg_raw.c, hg_raw.v, hg_raw.oi, hg_raw.s)

# Gold (GC) — NoAdjustment to preserve cross-commodity ratio
gc_raw = common_reference_futures(ticker=ReferenceFutures.GC)()
gc = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment)(gc_raw.o, gc_raw.h, gc_raw.l, gc_raw.c, gc_raw.v, gc_raw.oi, gc_raw.s)

# --- Copper/Gold Ratio ---
cu_au_ratio = ffill(hg.c) / ffill(gc.c)

# --- Signal: 63-day ROC of the ratio ---
ratio_roc = roc(period=63)(cu_au_ratio)

# Regime classification: rising (ROC > 0) vs falling (ROC <= 0)
is_rising = is_valid(ratio_roc) and ratio_roc > 0
is_falling = is_valid(ratio_roc) and ratio_roc <= 0
regime_label = conditional_select(is_rising, "Rising", is_falling, "Falling", "N/A")

# --- Forward 3-month SPY returns (63 trading days) ---
fwd_3m = forward_returns(period=63)(spy_close)

# Regime-filtered forward returns
rising_fwd = where(is_rising, fwd_3m)
falling_fwd = where(is_falling, fwd_3m)

# --- Hit rate (ternary for correct Mean calculation) ---
# Only defined on bars where regime is active AND forward return exists
rising_hit = where(is_rising and is_valid(fwd_3m), 1.0 if fwd_3m > 0 else 0.0)
falling_hit = where(is_falling and is_valid(fwd_3m), 1.0 if fwd_3m > 0 else 0.0)

# --- Timestamps for charts ---
ts = index().value

# --- 1. CONTEXT: Copper/Gold Ratio Over Time ---
xy_lines(
    title="Copper/Gold Ratio: The Macro Growth Barometer",
    y_axis_label="Cu/Au Ratio",
    x_axis_label="",
    category="Cu/Au → SPY Returns",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Cu/Au Ratio", color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="")
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=cu_au_ratio)

# --- 2. PUNCHLINE: Median Forward 3M Return by Regime ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title="Does a Rising Ratio Lead to Better SPY Returns?",
    x_axis_label="",
    y_axis_label="Median Fwd 3M Return",
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    category="Cu/Au → SPY Returns",
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Rising Cu/Au", color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Falling Cu/Au", color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero")
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(rising_fwd, falling_fwd))

# --- 3. DISTRIBUTION: Boxplot of Forward Returns by Regime ---
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.variadic,
    title="How Wide Is the Outcome Range?",
    x_axis_label="Regime",
    y_axis_label="Fwd 3M SPY Return",
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    category="Cu/Au → SPY Returns",
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    median_color=Color.White,
    whisker_color=Color.Slate,
    stem_color=Color.Slate,
    outlier_color=Color.Red,
    outlier_line_color=Color.Red,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Slate],
    series_names=["Rising Cu/Au", "Falling Cu/Au"],
    order=2
)(values=(rising_fwd, falling_fwd))

# --- 4. REFERENCE: Summary Stats Table ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category="Cu/Au → SPY Returns",
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Regime Statistics: Rising vs Falling Cu/Au Ratio",
        row_size=5,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=["Obs (Days)", "Median Fwd 3M", "Hit Rate (% Positive)", "Best 3M", "Worst 3M"],
        col_headers=["Rising Cu/Au", "Falling Cu/Au"],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(rising_fwd, falling_fwd, rising_fwd, falling_fwd, rising_hit, falling_hit, rising_fwd, falling_fwd, rising_fwd, falling_fwd)

# --- EVENT MARKERS: Regime Flips ---
regime_prev = regime_label >> 1
regime_changed = regime_label != regime_prev
is_flip_to_rising = regime_changed and is_rising
is_flip_to_falling = regime_changed and is_falling
flip_label = conditional_select(is_flip_to_rising, "Rising", is_flip_to_falling, "Falling", "N/A")
is_any_flip = is_flip_to_rising or is_flip_to_falling

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Cu/Au Regime Flip",
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="New Regime", type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title="ROC (63d)", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="Cu/Au Ratio", dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title="SPY Price", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(flip_label, ratio_roc, cu_au_ratio, spy_close, is_any_flip)
